Generic Token - Aura. 'When you play a non-attack action card, destroy this and the card gets go again.'

NOT IMPLEMENTED, deliberately empty rather than approximated -- the file exists so create_token stops aborting the game (require_card raises on a token with no definition), which is what eloquent_eulogy_red and grimoire_of_the_haunt need from it.

TWO SEPARATE THINGS ARE MISSING, and each one alone would make an approximation wrong:

1. ON_CARD_PLAYED REACHES ONLY THE HERO. engine._dsl_card_played_listener dispatches it to `players[pid].hero` and nowhere else, so an AURA cannot hear a card being played at all. The trigger would never fire.

2. THE GRANT IS ONE-SHOT AND THE DSL'S IS TURN-SCOPED. GRANT_KEYWORD_TO_PLAYED appends to player.dsl_play_keyword_grants, which lives until end of turn and applies to EVERY matching card played. Eloquence gives go again to the one card that destroyed it. Authoring it with the turn-scoped grant would hand go again to every non-attack action played for the rest of the turn -- strictly stronger than printed, and silently.

Writing a SET_FLAG here instead would look like an implementation and do nothing; see tests/test_no_dead_flags.py.
